component.name: iPod Shuffle
component.summary: Load music onto an iPod shuffle without iTunes

description.p: Manage an iPod shuffle 4th generation from Linux, with no iTunes and no Apple software of any kind.

The shuffle only plays tracks listed in iTunesSD, a binary database its firmware reads at startup, which is why copying files onto the device by hand does nothing. This application writes that database for you.

ul.li: Detects the iPod automatically as it is plugged in or unmounted
Copies music across and rebuilds the database in one step
Shows real song titles rather than the scrambled filenames on the device
Removes individual tracks and rebuilds the database safely
Wipes the device while preserving Apple's built-in spoken prompts
Backs up existing tracks, and the database that maps them to their titles
